MATCH (h:PlantItem {tag:'H-34201'}), (e:PlantItem {tag:'E-34201'})
OPTIONAL MATCH p = shortestPath((h)-[:line_to*]->(e))
WITH h, e, p
WITH EXISTS { (h)-[:line_to*1..]->(e) } AS reachable,
     p IS NOT NULL AS path_exists,
     CASE WHEN p IS NULL THEN null ELSE any(n IN nodes(p) WHERE n.tag = 'R-34201') END AS via_r
RETURN reachable,
       CASE
         WHEN NOT reachable THEN false
         WHEN via_r IS NULL THEN null
         ELSE NOT via_r
       END AS can_reach_without_r,
       CASE
         WHEN NOT reachable THEN 'no path from H-34201 to E-34201'
         WHEN via_r = false THEN 'yes: a route exists that does not pass through R-34201'
         ELSE 'shortest route passes through R-34201'
       END AS answer
